item.description: The _PySignalState class is missing the _prev_value attribute initialization in its constructor, causing AttributeError when accessing this attribute in the posedge and changed methods.
item.contract: The _PySignalState constructor must initialize the _prev_value attribute to match the signal's initial value, ensuring that posedge and changed methods can safely access this attribute without raising AttributeError.
item.acceptance: All tests with error pattern "AttributeError: '_PySignalState' object has no attribute '_prev_value'" should pass, including tests in test_sim.py and test_lib_crc.py.

item.description: The ClockDomain class equality comparison is not correctly implemented. The test_domain_lookup test expects ClockDomain objects to be equal when they have the same properties, but the current implementation may not properly compare all relevant attributes.
item.contract: The __eq__ method in ClockDomain must correctly compare all relevant attributes (name, clk_edge, async_reset, reset_less, local) to ensure proper object identity for domain lookup operations.
item.acceptance: The test_domain_lookup test in test_hdl_ir.py should pass, confirming that ClockDomain equality works correctly for domain lookup operations.

item.description: The posedge and changed methods in PySimEngine are attempting to access _prev_value on signal states that may not have this attribute initialized, causing AttributeError.
item.contract: The posedge and changed methods in PySimEngine must safely handle cases where _prev_value attribute is not yet initialized on signal states by checking for attribute existence and initializing it appropriately.
item.acceptance: Tests with error pattern "AttributeError: 'NoneType' object has no attribute 'tick'" and similar should pass.
